title: Sliders, Date Pickers & Range Inputs 🎚️
description: Make custom range sliders and date pickers perceivable and operable without a mouse.

slides.title: The Native Range Input 🎚️
slides.content:
`<input type="range">` is natively accessible: it's focusable, responds to arrow keys, and has an implicit role of `slider`.

* Always add a `<label>`.
* Use `aria-valuemin`, `aria-valuemax`, `aria-valuenow` if building custom.
* Native range is limited in styling; many roll their own.

If you build a custom slider, you must replicate all the built‑in semantics and keyboard support.

quizData.question: Which key increases the value of a native range input?
quizData.explanation: Arrow keys move the slider thumb; Up/Right increase, Down/Left decrease.

slides.title: Custom Slider Requirements 🛠️
slides.content:
A custom slider (div‑based) must have:

* `role="slider"`
* `tabindex="0"`
* `aria-valuemin`, `aria-valuemax`, `aria-valuenow`
* `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`
* Keyboard: Arrow keys change value, Home/End go to min/max.
* Mouse: drag thumb, click on track to jump.
* Touch: drag.

All interactions must update `aria-valuenow` in real time and announce the value (live region or `aria-valuetext`).

slides.title: Custom Slider Thumb

quizData.question: Which attribute gives a custom slider its current value to assistive tech?
quizData.explanation: `aria-valuenow` reflects the current numeric value of the slider.

slides.title: Date Pickers: A Complex Widget 📅
slides.content:
Native `<input type="date">` provides a fully accessible date picker – use it whenever possible.

Custom date pickers are among the most challenging widgets for accessibility. They typically involve:

* A text input (or readonly input with a button).
* A popup dialog/grid of dates (`role="dialog"` or `role="grid"`).
* Roving tabindex for day cells.
* Keyboard navigation: arrow keys move days, Page Up/Down changes months, Home/End.
* Focus trap inside the popup.

If you must build one, follow the ARIA Date Picker Dialog pattern precisely.

quizData.question: What is the most accessible way to let users pick a date?

options.text: Three separate text fields for day/month/year

quizData.explanation: The native date input provides built‑in keyboard, screen reader, and mobile support.

slides.title: Switches & Toggles 💡
slides.content:
A toggle (on/off) is essentially a checkbox with an immediate effect. Use `role="switch"` for a toggle control.

* `aria-checked` (true/false) instead of `aria-selected`.
* Space or Enter toggles it.
* Label should be clear: "Wi‑Fi" with checked=true means on.

Prefer a native checkbox with `role="switch"` added – it retains keyboard and form submission support.

slides.title: Pro Tip 🚀
slides.content:
## Don't forget touch
Sliders and date pickers must work on touch devices: swipe for slider, tap for date. Ensure drag targets are large enough.
